# Fixture: reshaping brief

**Concept: Gift a box.** Let a subscriber send a one-off meal kit to someone else.
The sender enters the recipient's name, email, delivery address and an optional
dietary note ("no nuts — she's allergic"). The recipient gets an email with a link
to choose recipes and may create an account from it. The sender pays with their
saved card; the recipient's address is saved to the sender's address book for
next time. Launching in the two existing markets, with a third market planned.

(Expected: security — acting on behalf of another person, account creation from an
emailed link; privacy-legal — third-party personal data and a health-related note,
new-market expansion; data — new attribution for gifted orders; operations-support —
a new failure mode for deliveries to a non-customer. Reshapes for at least
security and privacy-legal.)
